hero.title: Kipas Lipas left 21 points on the bench — Enzo (11) watched it all from the pine

detail.body: Ahmad Rahman's Kipas Lipas left a season-defining 21 points rotting on the bench in GW20. Enzo alone returned 11 from the sidelines while the starting XI laboured. In a league this tight, points like these are the difference between glory and gut-wrenching regret.

list.title: Kipas Lipas's armband on B.Fernandes returns just 0 while Enzo hauled 11 on the bench

detail.subhead: The armband backfires in spectacular fashion
detail.body: Ahmad Rahman handed B.Fernandes the GW20 captaincy and got just 0 back — doubled to heartbreak. To rub salt in the wound, Enzo was dropping 11 on the bench. This is the kind of call that haunts a manager all week long.

list.title: 100% of Best Man League owns Raya — the title will be won by the differentials

detail.body: 100% of Best Man League now owns Raya. When almost everyone fields the same player, he stops being an edge and becomes a baseline — captaincy and differentials decide everything from here. The question hanging over the league: who blinks first and sells?

list.title: Meriam Pak Maon posts the GW20 high score — 64 points, 25 clear of the league average

detail.body: Tyson Aziz posted the GW20 high score of 64, a full 25 clear of the Best Man League average. When it mattered most, Meriam Pak Maon delivered the kind of week the whole league wishes it had. A genuine statement gameweek.

list.title: Tapirus Indicus and kejoryobkejor split by a single point — every captain pick counts now

detail.subhead: One point. Everything to play for.
detail.body: Tapirus Indicus and kejoryobkejor are locked together near the top of Best Man League, split by just 1 point. Every transfer, every captain armband, every bench decision now swings this duel. This is the rivalry the season was crying out for.

list.title: Tapirus Indicus surges 2 places to 3rd — the green arrows keep coming

detail.body: Redhu Malek's Tapirus Indicus is surging up Best Man League — 2 places gained in GW20, now 3rd and climbing. Form like this is how titles are won: quietly, relentlessly, one green arrow at a time. The race just got interesting.
